name: Starter Kit
audience: Restaurants, patios, storefronts, hotel entrances and single commercial frontages
headline: One mega tree that listens to the room.
summary: The Starter Kit is a complete music-reactive mega tree: the Light Show controller box, USB microphone, pixel controller, power and the tree itself, configured before it ships. Join the controller's Wi-Fi from any phone, pick a theme or a music look, and set a schedule.

name: Business Kit
audience: Retail plazas, venues, hotels, offices and managed properties
headline: Roofline, mega tree and wrapped trees as one show.
summary: The Business Kit traces the main roofline of your building in pixels, adds a mega tree and wraps two existing trees, all running from one controller. Run a brand-colour look all year and switch to holiday themes on a schedule or a playlist.

name: Plaza / BIA Kit
audience: Business Improvement Areas, main streets, town squares and multi-tenant plazas
headline: A main street that lights up together.
summary: Sized for a block or a square: rooflines across three frontages, two mega trees, four wrapped trees and a pair of walk-through arches, synchronised from one control system. Each prop can run its own look, and the whole street can join one theme for events.
bestFor: Business Improvement Areas (BIAs, BIDs, BIZ, SDCs)

name: Municipal Program
audience: Municipalities, downtown programs, parks, civic squares and tourism offices
headline: A public light show your whole community comes out for.
summary: A civic-scale program: multiple mega trees, rooflines on civic and downtown buildings, wrapped trees along streets and in parks, evergreen spirals and an arch walkway, all scheduled from one system. Scoped in phases to fit budget cycles, with itemised quotes for council and procurement.
